answer.rationale: Use the low-cost quote as a benchmark to negotiate incumbent pricing and payment terms. This offers the best chance to reduce total cost while preserving established delivery continuity; switching primary supply with the line at 94% committed volume and no buffer would create material transition risk. Verify memory_c4 because it is the most directly relevant evidence that benchmark-based renewal negotiation can recover margin. It remains uncertain whether negotiation alone will achieve the full 18% mandate.
